_meta_note: budget-scenarios REQ-BSC-008 — minimal index/detail pages for BudgetScenario/BudgetScenarioModifier, plus the standalone BudgetScenarioComparison page (design.md §9). Nested into the existing 'Budgets' top-level group budget-core-schema.json already declares — mergeMenuItems (@conduction/nextcloud-vue buildManifest.js) unions children[] by id across fragments, so re-declaring the 'Budgets' id here with only this change's own children is the established either-order convention every sibling in this wave follows. That group is itself relocated into Cluster-4 'Banking & Cashflow' via src/menu-layout.json#relocations (see budget-core-schema.json's own _meta_note) — no change needed here.

config._note: REQ-BSC-001/002/009. A named cluster of dated modifiers compared side-by-side against the real budget (never mutating it). isDefault is set via the 'Promote to default' header action (BudgetScenarioController::promote -> BudgetScenarioDefaultPromoter, atomic demotion of any previous default), not a lifecycle transition (design.md §2a/§3). Publish/archive are ordinary status transitions. The modifiers related list is this scenario's own BudgetScenarioModifier rows.

headerActions.label: Promote to default
headerActions.successMessage: Scenario promoted to default; the previous default (if any) was demoted.
headerActions.errorMessage: Could not promote this scenario to default.

config._relatedCollectionsNote: THE KEY IS `relatedCollections`, NOT `relatedLists`. CnDetailPage's prop is `relatedCollections`; CnPageRenderer spreads config onto props, so a `relatedLists` block lands in $attrs and renders NOTHING while every gate stays green. THE FILTER TOKEN IS `@objectId`: BudgetScenarioModifier.scenarioId is `format: uuid` with `$ref: BudgetScenario`, so the child stores the parent's UUID, and BudgetScenario exposes no flat business key (administrationId/description/isDefault/name/status) for `@object.<field>` to read.

config._note: REQ-BSC-003/004/009. One dated modifier: RECURRING_END / RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE (targets a CashflowRecurring row by targetRecurId) or LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA (targets a LedgerGroup for effectiveDate's own month only). BudgetScenarioModifierGuard rejects a second RECURRING_* modifier in the same scenario on the same targetRecurId at save time (design.md §5a) — this page surfaces that as a save-time error, not a UI-level disablement.

pages.title: Scenario Comparison
pages._note: REQ-BSC-005/008, design.md §9. Custom because the page composes an administration/fiscal-year/scenario PICKER with a bespoke base/scenario/delta table calling BudgetScenarioController::evaluate() — none of the declarative page types (index/detail/dashboard) fit. Deliberately no `:id` route segment: the picker defaults to the administration's own isDefault=true scenario (REQ-BSC-002), so this page is reachable as a plain top-level nav entry rather than requiring the operator to first open a scenario's own detail page.
